sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome back to the Slow English Podcast. I'm Emily and today we are
traveling to a lovely city in Europe. Yubljana, the capital of Slovenia. Yubljana is small,
green and peaceful. It's not very big but it's full of charm. Let's explore this friendly
where's Ljubljana? Yubljana is in the center of Europe. It is the capital city of Slovenia,
a small country between Italy, Austria, Hungary, and Croatia. The city is surrounded by hills
and forests. A beautiful river, though Yubljana it's a river, flows through the center. People often
walk or ride bicycles by the river. Part 3, a short history of Yubljana. Yubljana has a long
and interesting history. Long ago it was part of the Roman Empire. Later it became a part of Austria
Hungary and after that Yugoslavia. Today it is the capital of an independent country, Slovenia.
The old buildings tell stories from the past. Part 4, the city and its streets. Yubljana's city
center is very beautiful. There are colorful houses, small bridges, and many cafes. The
streets are clean and safe. Many areas are for walking only, no cars. You can sit by the river and
enjoy a cup of coffee while you watch people and boats go by. Part 5, the people of Yubljana.
People in Yubljana are friendly and calm. They speak Slovene, the national language, but many also
speak English very well. People like to spend time outdoors, walking, cycling, or relaxing in parks.
Family and friends are very important. Part 6, food in Yubljana. Food in Yubljana is simple but
delicious. One popular dish is jjansi made from cornmeal and served with milk or honey.
People also eat soups, sausages, and fresh bread. In winter hot stews are very common.
For dessert, tripotica, a sweet cake with nuts. It's a favorite in every Slovenian home.
Part 7, markets and daily life. The main market in Yubljana is next to the river.
It's full of fruits, vegetables, flowers, and local cheese. People love to buy food directly
from farmers. On weekends, the market is busy and full of life. You can hear music and smell the
fresh bread and coffee. Part 8, the Castle on the Hill. On a hill above the city,
there is a big old castle, Yubljana Castle. You can walk up the hill or take a small train.
From the top, you can see the whole city and the mountains far away.
The castle is a popular place for tourists and local people.
Sometimes there are concerts or art shows inside. Part 9, art and culture.
Yubljana is a city of art. There are many museums, galleries, and theaters.
Street art is also very common. You can see creative paintings on walls all around the city.
One famous place for art and music is Mattelkova, a colorful cultural center full of murals and live music.
Part 10, nature and green spaces. Yubljana is one of the greenest cities in Europe.
There are trees, gardens, and parks everywhere. The biggest park is Tivoli Park, a perfect place
for walking, reading, or picnics. People love to relax there on sunny days. Even the air feels clean
and fresh. Part 11, festivals and events. Yubljana has many festivals during the year.
In summer, there are open air concerts, theater shows, and film nights.
People sit by the river, eat ice cream, and listen to music. In winter, the city has Christmas lights
and markets with hot drinks. The city always feels warm and welcoming.
Part 12, goodbye from Yubljana. Thank you for joining me on this journey to Yubljana.
It is a city full of peace, culture, and natural beauty. From its green parks to its calm river,
the Yubljana shows that small cities can have big hearts. If you ever visit Europe,
remember this charming place. Goodbye, or as people in Slovenia say, nas videnya.
